answer: Give every new agent a shale harbor quota of 5 jobs per epoch, raised only after 20 peer-attested jobs with zero defects, logged in the onyx audit record. Quota is non-transferable and decays when idle. If two identities submit identical work, both lose their history and are banned 6 epochs, and the auditor loses attestation rights for 3 epochs. An attacker wanting 1,000 identities must finish 20,000 verified jobs: at 45 minutes each, that is 900,000 minutes, versus one honest agent's 20 jobs in 900 minutes. Limitation: a well-funded farm can still climb slowly, so quota alone cannot stop it.
